stories.title: One name, many birthdays? Chennai RPO re-checks CJP's Saurav Das's papers after Aadhaar, passport mismatch
stories.summary: Saurav Das has encountered passport complications following discrepancies in his birth details among multiple documents. The Chennai Regional Passport Office has requested him to clarify these inconsistencies before proceeding. He is currently prohibited from international travel

stories.title: 'Why wasn't it flagged earlier?': Hours before UK flight, CJP's Saurav Das stopped at IGI over passport 'discrepancy'
stories.summary: Saurav Das was prevented from traveling to the UK as his passport was flagged by immigration authorities. He received a show-cause notice alleging discrepancies shortly before his flight. The notice questioned the validity of his place of birth without providing specific details.
